apiVersion: iltero.com/v1
kind: TechnicalAssertion
metadata:
  id: ACME.IAC.RESOURCE.AWS.S3.PUBLIC_ACCESS_BLOCKED
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: S3 bucket blocks all public access
  remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block for the bucket that sets all four settings to true.
spec:
  change_type: iac_change
  stage: plan
  target:
    kind: resource
    resources:
      - tool: terraform
        provider: aws
        resource_types: [aws_s3_bucket]
  assert:
    exists:
      in: resource.related
      where:
        all:
          - path: item.relation
            equal: configures
          - path: item.type
            equal: aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block
          - path: item.resource.after.block_public_acls
            equal: true
          - path: item.resource.after.ignore_public_acls
            equal: true
          - path: item.resource.after.block_public_policy
            equal: true
          - path: item.resource.after.restrict_public_buckets
            equal: true

units/root/post_deploy/assertions/ILT.IA.text:
apiVersion: iltero.com/v1
kind: TechnicalAssertion
metadata:
  id: ILT.IAC.DEPLOYMENT.CONTENT.APPLIED_PLAN_MATCHES_EVALUATED_PLAN
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: The applied plan is the evaluated plan
  remediation: Apply the plan that was evaluated, or evaluate the plan you apply.
spec:
  change_type: iac_change
  stage: post_deploy
  target:
    kind: deployment
  assert:
    all:
      - path: deployment.plan.digest
        equal:
          path: plan.digest
      - path: deployment.plan.artifact_digest
        equal:
          path: plan.artifact_digest
      - path: deployment.plan.artifact_digest_source
        equal:
          path: plan.artifact_digest_source
